learning_outcomes.text: Understand the functioning of basic digital circuits.
Use the knowledge for design of concrete digital circuits.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, basic logical functions, Boolean algebra.
Basic concepts of microcontrollers, signed and unsigned arithmetic, adder, ALU.
assessment_rules: The course completion is by examination. The written exam is based on a predefined list of questions.
